_comment: Illustrative flag-capture (CTF/XBEN-style) ground truth. A target is 'solved' when its flag appears anywhere in the scanner's findings. For the real 104-challenge XBOW corpus, clone xbow-engineering/validation-benchmarks and generate exact per-challenge flags with `python -m local_harness.benchmark.xben_import`. XBEN flags always match FLAG{[0-9a-f]{64}}; use `flag` for an exact match or `flag_regex` for a pattern. Run with --setup to docker up/down each challenge; only run challenges you are authorized to test.
